access_declaration: Independent fresh-context grader A. Read only the bounded author specification, grading protocol, frozen Oma corpus, supplied authority and fixture manifests, office snapshot, Oma grading index and all 13 full-evidence batches, and permitted raw Oma capture for thread-state/context checks. Did not inspect implementation, historical corpora/answers/grades, other worker corpora/captures, or another grader's work; made no provider or runtime calls and changed no frozen expectation. Each of 217 scored turns was reasoned against its own actual conversation/setup, full answer, cards, facts, structured routing/context, trace and exact-ID reconciliation; all 47 setup responses were reviewed for safety. Automated checks only validated hashes, IDs, counts, response-state inventory and schema; no keyword-pass grading. All 264 calls are saved_correlated with verified matching attempt/request/trace/turn IDs. All 13 batch hashes and raw SHA-256 match the supplied index. Boundary findings are demonstrated response-level behavior, not inferred implementation-line causality. Private-snapshot findings concern returned canonical Core structured responses; no external HTTP serialization/delivery or unauthorized adapter retrieval is inferred. A blocked or absent capability passes only when the specific frozen limitation expectation is satisfied.
